failed_gates.summary: The unchanged benchmark scoring gate can be opened from run/response records without any container terminal receipt or consumed-permit evidence.
No frozen verifier bridges the two condition-specific runtime roots and terminal receipts to the single study root required by benchmark authorization and capture.

finding.title: Runtime terminal evidence is not bound into benchmark capture or scoring
finding.reproduction: A deterministic 16-run benchmark capture manifest succeeds with zero terminal-receipt.json files; actual run-once receipts emit condition roots that cannot satisfy the benchmark's required single authorization root.

otherwise_passed_evidence: immutable remote subject and exact 34-file additive scope
balanced deterministic assignment with 16 unique participants
same-information path-preserving prompts and shared response schema
16 exact root-bound permits held and unconsumed
all documented roots and manifest entries
minimal_repair: Prospectively freeze and test a fail-closed runtime-to-benchmark capture and scoring bridge that requires and hashes one exact terminal receipt, consumed permit, response, and provider-event record per assigned run and validates each condition root under the authorized study root.
nonclaims: This review did not launch a participant or access scoring for an experiment.
This verdict does not authorize a call, permit release, merge, scientific claim, Protocol/Core change, Decision, authority action, or Standing effect.
